scripts.dev:stop: ids=$(docker ps -q --filter "label=devcontainer.local_folder=$PWD") && if [ -n "$ids" ]; then docker stop $ids; fi
scripts.dev:down: ids=$(docker ps -aq --filter "label=devcontainer.local_folder=$PWD") && if [ -n "$ids" ]; then docker rm -f $ids; fi
scripts.lint: devcontainer exec --workspace-folder . bash scripts/ensure-venv /opt/molight-venv/bin/ruff check custom_components tests scripts
scripts.lint:fix: devcontainer exec --workspace-folder . bash scripts/ensure-venv /opt/molight-venv/bin/ruff check --fix custom_components tests scripts
scripts.format: devcontainer exec --workspace-folder . bash scripts/ensure-venv /opt/molight-venv/bin/ruff format custom_components tests scripts
scripts.format:check: devcontainer exec --workspace-folder . bash scripts/ensure-venv /opt/molight-venv/bin/ruff format --check custom_components tests scripts
